tactics:
induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => intro h; cases l₂ with
    | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
    | cons b l => have := h b; simp at this
  | cons a l ih => intro h; have ha : a ∈ l₂ := by { rw [← List.count_pos_iff]; rw [← h]; simp }; exact (List.Perm.cons a (ih (fun x => by rw [List.count_erase, ← h]; simp [List.count_cons]; split <;> simp_all))).trans (List.perm_cons_erase ha).symm
